page.overview:
Who is Mrs. Bell?

Mrs. Bell is a minor character who appears in Live and Let Die. She is portrayed by Ruth Kempf.

Mrs. Bell is a woman in late middle age who is a student of Mr. Bleeker in the airport where James Bond is taken by Dr. Kananga's henchmen. In addition, Bond said Mr. Bleeker is sick and he will give the lesson to Mrs. Bell. They shake off the henchmen and destroy the wings of the plane. Afterwards she went to the intensive care.
